text:
eli: FYI seeing a spike of ContainerCreating hangs in us-west3 during the noon attach window — lots of pods stall ~25-40s. nvme util pegged. suspect cleaner overlap with bulk attaches.

nadia: can you paste the quick host snippets?

eli: pasted from one host (iostat + syslog):
```
# iostat -x 1 2
Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  avgrq-sz avgqu-sz  await  %util
nvme0n1         1400.0  3800.0  56000  480000     128.0     3.0   11.2   98.9
```
```
Apr 01 12:00:02 scrubber[4021]: begin async scrub nvme0n1 cohort=us-west3-9
Apr 01 12:00:03 kernel: nvme0n1: queue depth saturated, fallback throttle
Apr 01 12:00:04 kubelet: attach timeout waiting for ephemeral disk
```

nadia: that matches the scrub cadence flip we deployed. short-term: pause scrub on a small cohort and lower scrub ioprio so it yields. also add ephemeral_quiet label to avoid scheduler picking those hosts for bulk attaches.

eli: OK i'm going to label cohort us-west3-9 with infra.janitor.pause=true and set `scrub_ioprio=6` on the hosts.

ops-bot: [action] applied label infra.janitor.pause=true to cohort us-west3-9 at 1730001130

infra-hw: if util stays >95% after pause we should check thermal throttling and SMART counters. gather `nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0n1` for 5 hosts.

eli: applied scrub ioprio change at 1730001135. attach success for the batch wave jumped from ~65% -> ~97% in the first 3m. monitoring for 30m.

nadia: cost note: pausing scrubs will lengthen backlog and increase total scrub IO hours (~+4-6% over 24h), but avoids attach failures and wasted GPU time. worth it for now.

infra-hw: filed HW-7788 to collect SMART dumps and firmware versions from the impacted hosts if we see residual high util.

eli: created TICK-7788 and uploaded initial logs. leaving autoscaler hint (prefer_ephemeral_quiet=true) in place for 2h while scrub backlog decays.

ops-bot: [info] gpu-autoscaler: temporary prefer_ephemeral_quiet=true policy applied to cohort us-west3-9

nadia: follow-ups: RFC to integrate scrub-scheduler with attach forecasts (autoscaler), and an automated ioprio throttle when an attach wave is detected. also run cost calc for extended scrub window.

eli: agreed - filing RFC and pinging sched-team and infra-ops. will post a short postmortem if the pattern repeats. :thumbsup:
